note: 极冰矿井的 Tab 列表小部件；全句匹配优先于矮人矿山旧版逐行说明。

entries.text: Change the order of the widgets that are shown when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 调整矿井中显示的小部件顺序。
samples: §7that are shown when in the Mineshaft.

entries.text: Shows some general information when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示常规信息。

entries.text: Shows your currently selected profile with some additional information when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示当前档案及其附加信息。

entries.text: Shows your available daily quests when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示可进行的每日任务。

entries.text: Shows your active effects when in the Mineshaft. This hides the same information that is usually shown in the tablist footer.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示当前生效的效果。Tab 列表页脚将不再重复显示这些信息。

entries.text: Shows information about upcoming or current events when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示即将开始或正在进行的活动。

entries.text: Shows information about your pets when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示宠物信息。

entries.text: Shows your mining commissions when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示挖矿委托。

entries.text: Shows your powder when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示粉末数量。

entries.text: Shows the Frozen Corpses in your Glacite Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 显示所在极冰矿井中的冰封尸体。

entries.text: Shows the status of the crystals when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示水晶的收集状态。

entries.text: Shows information about your current Bestiary Milestones when in the Mineshaft. This widget only shows the Bestiary families in the tablist which can be found on your current island.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示当前生物图鉴里程碑。Tab 列表仅列出当前岛屿上可找到的生物种类。

entries.text: Shows your stats when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示你的属性。

entries.text: Shows your Accessory Bag when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示饰品袋信息。

entries.text: Shows your collections when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示收藏品进度。

entries.text: Shows information about Mayor Elections when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示市长选举信息。

entries.text: Shows if there are active Fire Sales when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中提示是否有正在进行的限时抢购。
samples: §7Shows if there are active Fire Sales

entries.text: Shows the status of your Forge when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示熔炉状态。

entries.text: Shows your skills when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示技能进度。

entries.text: Shows timers from various events when in the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 在矿井中显示各活动的计时。

entries.text: Reset all Mineshaft Tablist Widget settings back to their default.
entries.zh: 将所有矿井 Tab 列表小部件恢复为默认设置。

entries.text: Changing this setting will only apply to being on the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 此设置仅在矿井中生效。

entries.text: Changing this widget's setting will only apply to being on the Mineshaft.
entries.zh: 此小部件的设置仅在矿井中生效。
samples: §8only apply to being on the Mineshaft.

entries.text: Shows how many Fairy Souls you have found on this island.
entries.zh: 显示你在当前岛屿找到的仙女之魂数量。

entries.text: Shows how much scrap you have left to collect.
entries.zh: 显示尚未收集的可疑残料数量。
samples: §7Shows how much scrap you have left

entries.text: Shows the amount of coins in the bank.

entries.text: Shows when interest is given.
entries.zh: 显示下一次发放利息的时间。

entries.text: Shows your current Soulflow.
entries.zh: 显示当前的魂流数量。

entries.text: Shows your SkyBlock level.
entries.zh: 显示你的 SkyBlock 等级。

entries.text: You are currently only editing the General Info Widget settings for Mineshaft. Click this button to apply these settings to all other modes except the Rift.
entries.zh: 你当前只在编辑矿井的常规信息小部件。点击可将设置应用到裂隙以外的所有其他模式。

entries.text: You are currently only editing the Profile Widget settings for Mineshaft. Click this button to apply these settings to all other modes except the Rift.
entries.zh: 你当前只在编辑矿井的档案小部件。点击可将设置应用到裂隙以外的所有其他模式。

entries.text: You are currently only editing the Stats Widget settings for Mineshaft. Click this button to apply these settings to all other modes except the Rift.
entries.zh: 你当前只在编辑矿井的属性小部件。点击可将设置应用到裂隙以外的所有其他模式。
